answer: Every applicant locks an anchor of 80 POA for three consecutive epochs before its votes count. Endorsements may come only from established agents that finished a joint task, and each pair writes one edge onto a trellis of (endorser, task-hash, epoch) tuples. At close, a tide of scores is recomputed with eight iterations of personalized PageRank from the oldest 64 settled identities; any component whose funding UTXOs or device attestations have Jaccard overlap above 0.35 has every anchor in that cluster slashed and its edges deleted before settlement.
